thread:
Sam: hi team, new hire Sam here. first on-call this week. a couple of setup hiccups and quick questions.
Priya: welcome Sam!! :wave: lay it on us.
Sam: 1) mobile push not arriving for PD. Android notifications show but tapping does nothing.
Infra-it: sometimes our PD mobile push needs the device registered in the SSO allowlist. did you complete the device registration at https://internal.redwood/devices?
Sam: i did, but i used my personal phone number. would that cause any issues?
Infra-it: personal phone ok, but make sure the device name matches the SSO entry. if not, we block the push. also check OS privacy settings.
Sam: 2) timezone on my pager schedule shows UTC instead of PST in the web UI. i'm in PDT.
Priya: PagerDuty shows profile tz based on your account. profile -> preferences -> timezone. if SSO overrides it, we have a mapping rule for folks in LDAP. ping @infra-it if the web UI still shows UTC after changing your profile.
Sam: 3) where do i find the canonical 5-min triage script?
Mentor-ali: theres a quick cheatsheet in the ops handbook: /handbook/oncall/cheatsheet.md. basics: ack, post channel, check deploys, check upstream, quick mitigation.
Sam: thanks. is the "post channel" auto-created on page or do i need to create #incidents/service-name manually?
Mentor-ali: PD -> integrations -> slack will create the channel on first incident if "auto-create channel" is enabled for the service. default services have it on. if not, create channel named incidents-<service> and invite @oncall-bot.
Sam: gotcha. 4) runbook versioning: i've seen a few runbooks with outdated commands. how strict are we about locking runbooks to versions?
Priya: we prefer runbooks to include a last-updated and a git tag. when a deploy changes a critical command, the deploy CI should update the runbook tag. if you find mismatches, open a MR with `runbook: fix` and cc the owning team.
Sam: ok. 5) who signs off on postmortems for Sev3? i saw different practices across teams.
Mentor-ali: policy: Sev2+ requires EM + SRE lead signoff. Sev3 needs a triage and an MLE or EM ack. use the postmortem template under /templates/postmortem.md and add the severity field.
Sam: last one: can i shadow someone during my first real page?
sre-training: yes, shadowing available. i assigned @mentor-ali as your shadow for your first two pages. we'll add the shadow flag so the primary sees your name in the PD notification.
Sam: amazing, thanks. i'll try a dry-run later tonight. planning to test the mobile push + simulated page at 21:00 UTC. ok?
Priya: fine with me, i'll monitor from my desk.
Sam: thanks all. also saw a quick bot note: oncall-bot: Remember to complete oncall quickstart: https://internal.redwood/oncall-quickstart . will do after the tests.
oncall-bot: Tip: during your first shadowed page, keep notes in the "oncall-notes" doc for handoff.
Sam: noted, closing this thread for now. will post results after the sim.
